name: LLM_CHAT
description: A chat-completion model provider. One required action, `chat`: messages in, an assistant message (or a stream handle) out. The wire shapes here are the harness's own, not any vendor's; a provider plugin translates them to its API. Prose contract in docs/SPI.md. Schemas are documentation and tooling input: Gwead validates no payloads at dispatch.

chat.description: One model turn. With `stream` unset or false the model's whole reply comes back as `message`; with `stream: true` the result instead carries an integer stream handle yielding newline-delimited JSON events shaped by `streamEventShape`.

system.description: System prompt. A top-level field, not a message: `messages` roles are only `user` and `assistant`.

messages.description: The conversation so far, oldest first.

tools.description: Tools the model may call this turn. Derived from TOOL plugins' manifests (each `call` action's `tool` block); absent or empty means no tools.

max_tokens.description: Cap on generated tokens. Optional; the provider applies its own default and ceiling.

stream.description: Ask for the streamed output form.

oneOf.description: The buffered form (`stream` false or absent).

stream.description: A Gwead stream handle, valid only inside the execution that returned it. It yields UTF-8 newline-delimited JSON, one `streamEventShape` event per line, ending with an `end` event followed by end-of-stream. End-of-stream without an `end` event means the turn failed mid-stream.

oneOf.description: An increment of assistant text, to be concatenated in arrival order.

A complete tool call. Providers buffer partial tool-call deltas and emit the call whole: arguments are machine-consumed, so incremental display buys nothing and every consumer would otherwise reassemble JSON fragments.
The final event of every successful stream.

ToolUseBlock.description: The model asks for a tool. `id` is the provider's identifier for this call, echoed back by the matching ToolResultBlock; `input` is arguments per the tool's declared schema.

ToolResultBlock.description: A TOOL `call` result, carried back to the model in the next user message.

Tool.description: A tool offered to the model — a Gwead tool descriptor on the wire. `input_schema` is the JSON Schema for the call's arguments, taken verbatim from the TOOL plugin's `tool.parameters`.

StopReason.description: Why generation stopped: the model finished, the model wants tool results, or `max_tokens` was hit.
